capabilities: publish notes to a configured WordPress site
read post metadata such as title and tags from YAML front matter
write the WordPress post ID and categories back into front matter to support later edits
publish via the command palette or an optional side ribbon button
extras: The README warns that some hosts or sites disable XML-RPC, in which case publishing will not work; REST API with application passwords (WordPress 5.6+) is recommended instead. Further protocol details are on an external page.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a self-hosted WordPress site, so bloggers must copy and paste content manually.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses XML-RPC or REST protocol to publish to WordPress.

requires.name: WordPress username and application password (WordPress 5.6+ for REST API)

summary: Publishing plugin that sends Obsidian Markdown notes to a WordPress site via XML-RPC or the REST API.
